_comment: VERIFIED real organizations only. Every entry carries an official website URL for the farmer to verify; every URL re-checked live on 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200 — iwmi.org returns 403 to automated checkers but loads normally in a browser). No phone numbers, no partnerships, no contact persons are invented. Fields: states = regions served (empty = pan-India), services from a fixed tag list.

organizations.name: NABARD
organizations.note: Rural development bank; publishes watershed and irrigation programs.

organizations.name: Indian Institute of Soil Science (IISS), Bhopal
organizations.note: National institute under ICAR for soil health research.

organizations.name: National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning (NBSS&LUP)
organizations.note: ICAR institute producing soil resource maps of India.

organizations.name: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB)
organizations.note: Central Ground Water Board — groundwater assessment and artificial recharge guidance.

organizations.name: IWMI (International Water Management Institute) — India
organizations.note: Research on water management in agriculture.

organizations.name: WRI India
organizations.note: World Resources Institute India — water and agriculture programs.

organizations.name: Karnataka State Soil Health Card scheme (Dept. of Agriculture, Govt. of Karnataka)
organizations.note: State soil testing and advisory program.

organizations.name: Maharashtra State Soil and Water Conservation Dept.
organizations.note: State watershed and soil conservation programs.

organizations.name: Agricultural universities (state-wise ICAR universities)
organizations.note: ICAR network — local krishi vigyan kendras provide district-level extension support.

organizations.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs)
organizations.note: District-level ICAR extension centers — closest practical point of contact for a farmer.
